notes.title: Workshop Integration (Patch Notes 1.4.0)
notes.content:
Workshop integration is here! Now let's see all your cool level creations.
Note: Levels can only be subscribed to through the steam client (Not in game)

Workshop Integration
Upload your creations to steam workshop or play and rate levels from other players!

 A new "Publish to workshop" button is clickable in the level editor
 Levels must have unique names per user
 Subscribing to levels automatically adds them to the custom/editor level selection screens 


Level Editor

 A thumbnail is now auto-generated upon saving a level so you can more easily recognize your levels when you come back to them.


UX improvements
Some minor improvements to make text more readable

 Level editor status messages (e.g. "Save Successful") now have a background to ensure readability
 Changed the background colour and font size of the yes/no dialog box to reduce eye bleeding

notes.title: Level Editor improvements (Patch Notes 1.3.0)
notes.content:
Hi guys, I've been working on some other projects since the release of Cup of Ethanol, but I finally got back to improving the level select screen.

This is also a pre-update to prepare for potential workshop integration. I will give workshop integration a go, but if it turns into weeks of work I can't afford to do it.
So hopefully it's not too difficult to get working 🤞🤞🤞

Custom Levels

 Custom levels can be named and renamed (32 character limit)
 Custom levels can be deleted


Custom level select screen

 Custom level names are now shown instead of just a number (Note: You will have to rename any existing levels or it will still show the number)
 Empty level folders are not shown in the level list


Minor changes
Shows a specific error message when invalid enum opengl error occurs (since this happens often sadly 😢)

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.2.0
notes.content:
I got some feedback on some bugs and improvements, so I've uploaded a new update.

Added 3 new achievements for coaster collecting
I felt that after collecting the first 40 coasters, there will be less motivation to reach the final 72 coasters, since it only gives 1 additional achievement. I added 3 more achievements at 50, 60 and 70 coasters to give a greater sense of progress. So collect away!

Impossible to reach coaster
All of the coasters on level 2 are now possible to collect. There was a platform that was too far to reach, and this is now fixed.

Coaster difficulty balance
Added some extra checkpoints on level 8 so the coaster difficulty is more in line with the rest of the game

notes.title: Achievements, Gamepad support, and the future of Cup Of Ethanol
notes.content:
Pre-release progress update

 Achievements are now ready (There are 10 in total)
 Basic gamepad support added (no customization possible)

Plans for future updates
There will be no workshop integration upon release, but initially I plan to accept custom levels from the community and add them to the game myself via updates.

If we get a few people using this feature, then I will take some time to integrate steam workshop, but I'd rather manually add community levels at first

Thanks for reading
